components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 11px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 15px; background: #202a23; color: #fffdf8; font: 700 12px/1.3 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button:hover { background: #3f5143; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8c3b28; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:active { background: #3f5143; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #303830; font: 700 12px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #a9a69c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 11px; background: #fffdf8; color: #20211f; font: 400 13px/1.5 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #74402e; outline: 2px solid #74402e; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8c3b28; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-masthead { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; border-block: 3px double #292b28; padding: 11px 0 16px; text-align: center; } .ds-note { order: 1; margin: 0 0 3px; color: #4c5948; font: 700 11px/1.6 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-wordmark { order: 2; color: #20211f; font: 600 clamp(30px, 4vw, 42px)/1.2 Literata, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-masthead nav { order: 3; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 30px; margin-top: 13px; font: 600 12px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-masthead nav a { padding: 3px 0; color: #3f4940; text-decoration: none; } .ds-masthead nav a:hover { color: #913d2b; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-masthead a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8c3b28; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-post-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 138px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c2beb3; padding: 25px 0 27px; } .ds-meta { padding-top: 5px; color: #50564f; font: 400 11px/1.55 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-post-row h2 { margin: 0; color: #20211f; font: 500 25px/1.28 Literata, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-post-row h2 a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-post-row h2 a:hover { color: #913d2b; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-post-row p { max-width: 66ch; margin: 8px 0 0; color: #50564f; font: 400 14px/1.7 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-post-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; padding-block: 21px 23px; } .ds-meta { padding: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
Newspaper wayfinding frames the reading experience: a centered masthead, double rules, compact metadata, and ruled story rows organize the index without competing with the posts. Literata brings the editorial voice to titles and article copy; Manrope handles navigation, metadata, and controls with a clear, contemporary counterpoint.

The public pages stay quiet and legible, with warm paper, dark ink, olive details, and a restrained red-brown accent. Admin screens use the same palette and type system, adding compact controls and status markers for task clarity. The source defines a light appearance, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion handling.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces, ink text, olive wayfinding, and sparing red-brown accents
Serif-led headlines and article reading, sans-serif interface labels
Flat, ruled layouts with minimal rounded control surfaces
dos: Do keep article text in the narrow serif reading column and preserve its generous line-height.
Do use rules, alignment, and whitespace to organize public content.
Do keep focus indicators visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add heavy shadows to surfaces; depth is carried by tonal contrast and rules.
Don't turn public post rows into raised, rounded cards.
Don't introduce additional font families or accent colors without updating the established palette.
